user_story: As a user, I want to filter tasks by priority so that I can work on the most urgent items first.

positive.title: Filter tasks by high priority successfully
steps: Select 'High' from the priority filter dropdown
positive.expected_result: Only tasks with high priority are displayed

positive.title: Filter tasks by medium priority successfully
steps: Select 'Medium' from the priority filter dropdown
positive.expected_result: Only tasks with medium priority are displayed

positive.title: Filter tasks by low priority successfully
steps: Select 'Low' from the priority filter dropdown
positive.expected_result: Only tasks with low priority are displayed

positive.title: Apply multiple filters successfully
steps: Select 'High' from the priority filter dropdown
Select 'Incomplete' from the status filter dropdown
positive.expected_result: Only incomplete tasks with high priority are displayed

negative.title: Attempt to apply filter with no tasks present
steps: Navigate to the tasks page with an empty task list
Select 'High' from the priority filter dropdown
negative.expected_result: Display a message indicating no tasks match the filter criteria

negative.title: Filter tasks with an invalid priority
steps: Enter an invalid priority value (e.g., 'Very High')
negative.expected_result: Display a validation error message for invalid priority

edge.title: Filter tasks when all tasks are of the same priority
steps: Select 'Low' from the priority filter dropdown
edge.expected_result: All displayed tasks should be low priority items

edge.title: Filter tasks when there is only one task available
steps: Select 'High' from the priority filter dropdown
edge.expected_result: The single task with high priority should be displayed

edge.title: Check filtering performance with a large number of tasks
steps: Navigate to the tasks page populated with 10,000 tasks
Select 'High' from the priority filter dropdown
edge.expected_result: The filtered tasks are displayed in a reasonable amount of time without performance degradation
